name: All Time Plastics Ltd
title: All Time Plastics Ltd - 544479 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue flat at INR145.8 cr with volumes hit by polymer shortages and 10-15% shipment slippage into April; capacity at 39,000 t with 6,000 t expansion now gated on demand, utilisation guided 70-75%.

utilisation.quote: the installed capacity, which is available, so that we have averaged out is 73%

capex.quote: we will wait and decide further how we take it forward to take the total capacity to 52,500 tons

triggers.label: Capex phase 2 deferred pending demand
triggers.quote: we will wait and decide further how we take it forward

triggers.label: Price hikes 22-25% vs 10-12% absorbed
triggers.quote: the price increases are going up to the range of 22% to 25% increase from our current base levels

triggers.label: Q4 shipments slipped 10-15% into April
triggers.quote: it was about, we expressed about 10% to 15% over the quarter

triggers.label: FY27 utilisation 70-75% guided
triggers.quote: we are looking between 70% to 75% because we are still very sceptical

guidance.quote: we are looking between 70% to 75% because we are still very sceptical
FY27 we are targeting to complete at least the 6000 metric ton what we were targeting
So, year wise in '26 -'27, we are looking at a better margin than what we have done in '25 - '26.

guidance.value: INR60 cr at max utilisation on INR15 cr capex
guidance.quote: the capex investment will go to about INR15 crores overall and the revenue, sales revenue will be roughly about INR60 crores

red_flags.label: Price pass-through lag and margin hit
red_flags.quote: the pass-through happens with an 8-week delay

red_flags.label: Margin guidance vague, no numbers
red_flags.quote: it will definitely increase once the revenue increases

evasions.quote: we cannot comment on any future looking statements
We cannot make a guess that way.
